announced on Thursday that it entered a $725M equipment
to expand capacity for growing AI-native cloud customer demand.
The company plans to use the financing to purchase GPUs, CPUs, and other equipment for its AI-Native Cloud platform.
The facility also includes an option to add up to $300M of additional financing, subject to lender commitments and other conditions.
The company said the financing will help fund capacity expansion while aligning cash outflows with revenue.
It reaffirmed its Q3 and full-year 2026 guidance and 2027 outlook, citing accelerating demand for its AI-native cloud.

title: DigitalOcean secures $725M facility to meet AI cloud demand
